metadata.family: None identified, bespoke Python/paramiko adversary-in-the-middle platform
handling_notes: The 41 third-party relay hosts carrying this interceptor are COMPROMISED VICTIMS, not operator infrastructure. They are deliberately absent from this feed and belong to a notification track.
The 140 named victim hosts, the capture-range /24s and 31 recovered mailbox addresses are victim identifiers and are deliberately absent from this feed.

Activity was observed arriving from Tor exit infrastructure. The specific address is a shared exit relay used by thousands and is deliberately omitted; publishing it as operator infrastructure would defame its operator.
The receiver's historical passive-DNS names (last resolved 2021-07 to 2022-10) belong to prior tenants of a recycled provider IP and must never be attributed to this operator.

Third-party criminal infrastructure the operator preyed on (commodity-loader C2 panels, an age recipient key, harvested XMPP/GPG identities recovered from a captured toolkit) belongs to a different actor and is deliberately absent from this feed.
Recovered operator credentials and API keys are disclosure-track only and appear nowhere in this feed.

entries.reason: WITHHELD FROM THE MACHINE-READABLE FEED. This is a legitimate commercial mobile-proxy service with unrelated paying subscribers, and its carrier CGNAT exits are shared with real users. The operator was a customer of it; that makes it an attribution artifact, not attacker infrastructure. Publishing it in a blockable feed risks consumers auto-ingesting it and cutting off innocent subscribers, the same harm class as publishing a shared Tor exit relay as operator infrastructure. The tradecraft finding (nine sticky-session credentials with UK exit tags, recovered from the Sealed Fallback blob in the jailbreak prompt) is retained in the report narrative.

original_assessment.purpose: Mobile proxy service used for operator egress, recovered from the Sealed Fallback base64 blob in the jailbreak prompt
original_assessment.notes: Nine sticky-session credentials with UK exit tags. Carrier CGNAT exits are shared with real subscribers
original_assessment.false_positive_risk: Commercial proxy service with legitimate customers. Treat as an attribution artifact, not a blocking indicator

non_indicators.warning: CONTEXT ONLY - DO NOT INGEST AS INDICATORS, DO NOT BLOCK, DO NOT ALERT ON THESE VALUES. They are recorded so analysts can read the campaign evidence correctly. Every value here is non-routable, victim-internal, or otherwise unsafe to match on: matching it would fire on the consumer's own loopback or private network rather than on adversary activity. Automated ingestion must skip this block. It is deliberately outside network_indicators for that reason.
